mapper.select: SELECT id, page_key, page_title, content, remark, updated_by, updated_at FROM sys_page_content ORDER BY id
SELECT id, page_key, page_title, content, remark, updated_by, updated_at FROM sys_page_content WHERE page_key = #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_page_content(page_key, page_title, content, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES(#{pageKey}, #{pageTitle}, #{content}, #{updatedBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE page_title = #{pageTitle}, content = #{content}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW()
